verdict: APPROVED. All four assigned expanded-profile frames are readable, correctly aligned and free of clipping, both at the n293 batch opening and the n309 closing, at 1280 and 390 wide. Source-link markers are visible, and the words shown, including the fixed בקול/כהנים, are correctly separated. The closing shows only the priestly-blessing introduction, ending 'כָּאָמוּר:' / 'as it is said:'. Visible Hebrew and English labels then say that scan312 onward is not yet encoded, which is accurate for an incomplete book (311 complete leaves, partial 351, 44 incomplete). The browser checks are clean. Two limits: the מסיים/ברוך fix does not appear in the assigned frames and was accepted on your statement, and the other two profiles' screenshots were not part of this review.
